_doc: The 2026-11-04 Jan-asks census (firstmate lane jan-asks-intake-fable-j1), measured 2026-10-21T21:51Z..2026-11-04T22:45Z from 155 Slack conversations the bots can read. One row per classified Jan ask (269 rows: the census's 301 excludes the 88 #cs_priority triage acks and the unclassified tail). `text` is the census's own trimmed rendering, i.e. the exact bytes the census classifier saw - the fixture pins scripts/ops_intake/classes.py to the classifier the census used, not to a re-typed approximation. `census_class` is the census label verbatim; `expected_class` maps the census's extra labels onto the router's ten classes (relay-to-firstmate -> relay, process-question -> other). Provenance: /home/aaron/Projects/firstmate/data/jan-asks-intake-fable-j1/census-appendix.md. scripts/ops_intake/classes.py must score >= 95% on `expected_class` (tests/test_ops_intake.py::CensusAgreement). Labels encode the census classifier's own choices; the residual is listed in that test so a regression cannot hide inside the 5%.
